intro-1-1.text: Wake Squadron, this is Harrow! The Furnace column is burning its way across Dustline. Stop it before it reaches the river!

intro-2-1.text: Saltpan was our listening post once. Now it's their depot. Burn it, and their whole front goes hungry.

intro-3-1.text: The Foundry builds their gunships day and night. Today it builds nothing! Hit the Anvil and don't stop!

intro-4-1.text: The Twin leads their fleet. Break it, and the strait is ours. Harrow holds as long as you do!

intro-5-1.text: Heartfall. The Crown has shelled our coast for six years. I lost my first squadron under those guns. I will not lose this one!

after-1-3.text: Hold the cheering. Their supply road runs on through Saltpan.

after-3-2.text: Wake, Harrow is taking fire! Their fleet came out of Twinsea behind us. Get back here, now!

after-4-2.text: Still here, Lead. The bridge is full of smoke, but I'm here. Heartfall is open. Finish it.

ending-halden.text: Four ships out, four ships coming home. The war is over, pilots. Bring them in gently.

brief-sora-1.text: Lieutenant Sora. Seven years ago the Dominion shelled your lighthouse at Cape Merrow. You turned that lamp by hand until dawn.

brief-sora-3.text: Tonight the whole coast needs that lamp. You lead Wake Squadron to Heartfall, and you bring every one of them back.

brief-rook-1.text: Rook. Two crashes behind enemy lines, and you walked home from both.

brief-rook-3.text: Then that was your last free one. The Dominion is moving on Port Lyle. You fly wing with the best pilots I have left.

brief-mina-1.text: Mina. At Saltpan you heard their fleet coming, and nobody believed you.

brief-mina-3.text: I'm listening now. Every channel you catch out there comes straight to my bridge.

brief-tevi-1.text: Tevi. First sortie, and it's over Dustline. Your family's farm is under that smoke.

brief-tevi-3.text: Then you know what we're fighting for. Stay close to your squad and don't fly angry.
